# Elite bot command trace baselines for common/src/bots_trace_tests.rs.
# One block per libm fingerprint: "baseline <libm> <label>", then per
# scenario a "scenario <name>" line, its summary line and one digest per
# simulated second.
# The first blocks were recorded from the pre-refactor brain (origin/dev
# ce04e5f plus the trace test only). LR-10 (route-planning budget,
# 2026-10-24) changed Elite movement on purpose: a bot plans a route at most
# once per ROUTE_INTERVAL and walks a clear straight line in between. Both
# blocks below are recorded from that change (commit a42608c): the glibc
# 2.39 block is CI's elite-bot-trace artifact (run 40091705808), the macOS
# block comes from the owner's Mac. The glibc 2.43 (vds-dev builder) block
# was stale and is removed until it is re-recorded there; without it the
# comparison is only skipped on that libm.
# A commit that changes gameplay on purpose re-records these blocks; see
# "Re-baselining" in the module docs of common/src/bots_trace_tests.rs.
